
EXPORT-EXAMPLE-MAP
Export Example Mapping data from work unit to JSON file

USAGE
  fspec export-example-map <workUnitId> <file>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <file> (required)
    Output JSON file path

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Export Example Mapping
  $ fspec export-example-map AUTH-001 example-map.json
  ✓ Exported Example Mapping to example-map.json

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec import-example-map
  fspec show-work-unit
